name: Mosquito Cloud Trap (CR 7)
body:
Mosquito Cloud Trap
CR 7

XP 3,200

Type mechanical; Perception DC 25; Disable Device DC 25

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset none

Effect disease-carrying mosquitoes; never miss; onset delay (1 round); DC 12 Fortitude or contract bonecrusher fever

This trap releases a cloud of mosquitoes into the air. The insects buzz and swarm around the victim’s head. A bitten character begins to develop rashes on their body and is at risk of contracting a painful illness known as bonecrusher fever. The mosquito swarm is quick to disperse once they have bitten their target.
